scientific_integrity: The conclusions are integral Chow-zero-cycle identities and require the smooth-curve CSM theorem and standard finite point-pinching; no independent validation, new higher-dimensional theorem, or complete historical priority is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Over the complex numbers; projective schemes whose support has dimension at most one. Only degree-zero CSM classes, not full characteristic classes. Polynomial cutoff requires all normalized curve components to have positive genus and no isolated points. Originality depends on an extension of gluing arguments from an already published irreducible-curve theorem.
title: An integral Macdonald identity for all projective curves, with sharp branch-corrected vanishing
